text:
OpsBot: ALERT: apiserver 503 spike in eu-west1 (control-plane) - 12% error rate over 3m, leader changes observed :warning:
Sara (oncall): I'm seeing controller-manager restarts correlated with the spike, noderef failures from GPU pools
Devon: curious if GPU node churn is causing heavy informer churn and controller reconciliation pressure
Jia: logs show lots of watch reconnects + kvcache misses. snippet:
```
E0301 12:01:02.345 controller-manager.go:123] sync failed: watch closed by apiserver: EOF
etcd: detected leader change, term 87->88
apiserver: 503 returning on list pods
```
Luca: interesting — current GPU autoscaler is evicting and recreating nodes across AZs to satisfy affinity, lots of attach/detach ops hitting cloud API
Maria: cloud attach latency is up to 2s for GPUs in eu-west1-b per recent metrics, that will amplify pod churn
Sara (oncall): can we throttle autoscaler or pin some GPU pools? this is impacting ctrlplane stability and causing customer-facing 503s
Devon: agree. temp mitigation: flip autoscaler to conservative mode and reduce scale-down to 10% with 15m stabilization window
Jia: also we should bump apiserver kube-apiserver connection & watch buffer limits and increase etcd election timeout slightly to avoid leader flapping while cloud ops stabilizes
Luca: ops note — increasing etcd disk iops for eu-west1 cluster would reduce WAL stall risk but >costy. estimated additional $1.2k/day for the region if we provision higher throughput NVMe
Maria: cost vs availability call: we have two options: 1) short-term: increase etcd IO + disable autoscaler (costly, fast), 2) medium-term: tweak controller-manager leader-election & informer resyncs + pin GPU node affinity (cheap, slower)
Sara (oncall): deploy plan? I'm going to: 1) flip autoscaler to conservative now (Devon pls approve), 2) apply controller-manager leader-election tweak (increase lease duration from 15s->45s) as a canary
Devon: approved. I'll push autoscaler change (one-liner) and monitor 5m
Jia: I'll open a quick runbook PR with the watch/connect tuning and the log snippet for postmortem
Luca: I'll open cloud ticket to investigate attach latency trend and request temporary higher iops as emergency if situation worsens
Maria: tagging finance for the $ impact if ops escalates - @finance FYI :money_with_wings:
OpsBot: NOTE: autoscaler mode switch executed by Devon at 3141592678; monitor alerts will update in 2m
Sara (oncall): thanks team. if 503s don't drop in 10m we escalate to oncall+eng-runtime
Devon: autoscaler change in, watching apiserver error rate now :eyes:
Jia: seeing fewer watch disconnects already (small sample). we'll keep an eye and add to postmortem
Sara (oncall): marking this thread for postmortem. TL;DR: GPU affinity-driven node churn caused attach latencies -> informer churn -> apiserver 503s; mitigations: throttle autoscaler, leader-election tuning, consider increasing etcd IO if persistent.
